cellRule: every operation-by-host-by-profile cell has exactly one producer node and one receiving acceptance ID, or is a truthful exclusion with a reason

acceptanceGap.gap: MDX9-AC2 checks use-site diagnostic agreement with the oracle but no producer AC discriminates an in-.mdx diagnostic remapped to the wrong authored range; MDX6's acceptance covers hover/definition (MDX6-AC2) and the .tsx importer (MDX6-AC3) only
acceptanceGap.discriminatingCase: a type error inside an .mdx {expression} region is published once by tsgo at its exact authored range; a planted off-by-one projection map fails
acceptanceGap.routedTo: MDX6 (producer) through the controller as a charter amendment adding that case to its acceptance; MDX9-AC2 stays the receiving item until the amendment is ratified

componentCandidateRule.rule: a JSX component completion or auto-import candidate is offered only for an export proven to be a React component (MDX3 use-site surface over RCT3's React facets, resolved through MDXR0's provider chain at MDX1M); a capitalised name is never proof, and a non-React profile or generic MDX still parses and binds without React
componentCandidateRule.source: MDX0 charter, Predecessor contracts (MDXR0 matrix rules); MDX1M amendment: no capitalised-name heuristic
componentCandidateRule.discriminatingCase: in one fixture, a capitalised export that is not a proven React component (for example `export const Title = 'x'`) is not a component auto-import candidate, while a proven React component export (`export function Note(props) { return <aside>{props.children}</aside> }`) is

acceptanceGap.gap: MDX5-AC2 discriminates duplicate results but not the component-candidate rule
acceptanceGap.routedTo: MDX5 (producer) through the controller as a charter amendment adding the discriminatingCase of componentCandidateRule to MDX5-AC2

acceptanceGap.gap: MDX9-AC1 is a generic coverage join; no MDX5 AC discriminates the export and layout symbols
acceptanceGap.discriminatingCase: the document-symbol tree contains each named ESM export and the layout default export under MDX1S's outline at exact ranges; a planted symbol for an import (not an export) fails
acceptanceGap.routedTo: MDX5 (producer) through the controller as a charter amendment adding that case to its acceptance; MDX9-AC1 stays the receiving item until the amendment is ratified

productEvidenceRule.rule: no cell cites a proof node, an installed parser or highlighting as product evidence; a cell is evidenced only by its producer's acceptance

notes: Cells cover the mdx-react profile, the only admitted profile. Every operation a plan node delivers for MDX has a cell or an exclusion: MDX1S's structure features (C34-C38), MDX8F's carrier formatting views (C39-C41), MDX8F-MD's Markdown content formatting (C42), and MDX1G's client grammar as exclusion X12. A cell carrying acceptanceGap names a receiving AC that does not yet discriminate the operation; the gap is routed to the producer through the controller, and the named receiving AC holds until the amendment is ratified. MDX10-AC1/AC4 hold the terminal: the generated rows equal this matrix and no cell shrinks to unsupported without a ratified replan.
